message.content:
An editorial illustration with a yellow background features a large, smiling man centered on the page. He wears a grey short-sleeved button-down shirt, brown trousers, black shoes, and a dark peaked officer's cap. A large hoe rests across his shoulders, held by his right hand. In his left arm, he cradles a woven basket filled with several ears of corn. To his right, a much smaller man in a white shirt, dark pants, and a conical hat is shown in a dynamic, off-balance pose with his arms raised.

The top of the page displays "TEMPO" in large red letters, with "55" in white to the right. Text above the title reads "Proyek Kampung Haji Danantara H.48" and "Deradikalisasi Eks Personel Jamaah Islamiyah H.40." Below the title, smaller red text reads "ENAK DIBACA DAN P."

Large black text on the left states "KEBUNKU PENUH POLISI." Smaller text below reads, "Presiden Prabowo menugasi polisi dalam program ketahanan pangan, makan bergizi gratis, dan penstabilan harga beras. Ada indikasi angka produksi jagung diutak-atik agar terlihat berhasil. H.26." The bottom-left corner contains publication details for "23-29 MARET 2026," a price of "RP 60.000," a barcode, and a QR code.
